findings.suggested_fix: Use more internationally intelligible, contemporary Portuguese for the title. Replace "Deveis Nascer de Novo" with "Deveis nascer de novo" or, better, the more natural modern phrasing: "Deveis nascer de novo" → "Deveis" is archaic; recommended: "Deveis nascer de novo" (if keeping formal address) or the most natural: "Deveis Nascer de Novo" → "Deveis" → "Devem Nascer de Novo" / "Deves Nascer de Novo" depending on intended audience. Prefered single recommended fix: change to "Devem Nascer de Novo" for broadly intelligible modern Portuguese.

findings.source_quote: A pale crocus blooming through melting snow
findings.suggested_fix: Improve naturalness and fluency in Portuguese alt text. Replace "Um açafrão pálido florescendo através da neve a derreter" with a more idiomatic rendering such as "Um açafrão pálido florescendo na neve que derrete" or "Um crocus pálido florescendo na neve derretendo." If preferring the botanical term, use "crocus" instead of "açafrão": "Um crocus pálido florescendo na neve que derrete."
findings.translation_quote: Um açafrão pálido florescendo através da neve a derreter
